reviews.text:
I want to sincerely thank Dr. Jommi, who supported my dog ​​Zoe throughout her BOAS journey. She was always available, attentive, and professional, but what we especially appreciated was her great humanity, which always made us feel in good hands.

The operation went very well, and today my dog ​​is definitely better, breathing easier, and much more serene. We are truly happy with the result and grateful to the doctor for everything she did for her. ❤️

I absolutely recommend her!
Thank you for your positive feedback! Pet welfare and owner satisfaction are our top priorities.

From a veterinary clinic, as we're all used to... you don't expect it. You don't expect such incredible dedication to their work, such extraordinary empathy, such top-notch professionalism, and such incredible kindness. I had the opportunity to interact with Dr. Jommi, who treats my dog ​​for arthritis, which we're treating together with excellent results, and with Dr. Marassi for an intestinal and dermatological issue that we're resolving with her therapies. What can I say, they treat our animal friends as if they were their own. Their prices are absolutely in line with other vets, with the only difference being that they're WELL SPENT given their approach to care and their approach to both humans and animals. Thank you for existing and thank you for your invaluable work.

Pure arrogance and bullying from a receptionist. My wife made an appointment the night before for the next morning with a dermatologist. NO ONE asked us for any advance payment. Since I had to have some blood tests done, we were told that the cat can't eat 8 hours before, so I took the food away from the night before. In the morning, I found him eating while digging in the bag, so she called to apologize and to reschedule the appointment for the next day or even the following week.
The first lady who answered understood the situation and said okay, then another lady called back who with inappropriate aggression started to say that we had to pay for the appointment in very aggressive tones, lecturing us as if we were a 10-year-old girl, she said that for the next appointment for next week there was no problem leaving a deposit, something that she had not been informed of on the first call, but given these tones I prefer not to take it and she replied "and I am very happy about that", I wonder what way this is to treat a potential client who needed long-term care, instead of looking after the health of the animal the priority was to ask for money, I'm sorry, one star is not for the doctors, but for the way they treat people,

A very negative experience.

I called the clinic the night before to schedule an appointment for my cat, who has suffered from severe atopic dermatitis for years and is undergoing treatment for an immune disorder. During the call, I explained his situation and asked whether it would be better to book with a general practitioner or a specialist. I was told that I could come to the clinic and that the doctors would decide together which was the most suitable vet. For this reason, I wasn't even aware that the appointment had been scheduled directly with the dermatologist.

The morning of the appointment, my cat managed to eat some kibble, even though I was trying to fast him for the blood tests. I immediately called the clinic to let them know and ask if it was possible to reschedule the appointment, because I'm from outside Milan and wanted to avoid unnecessary travel and stressing my cat out more than necessary.

The receptionist was initially helpful. Shortly afterward, however, I was called back by someone else, and the conversation was very unpleasant. I tried several times to explain that I believed the appointment was primarily for a general assessment and blood tests, and that I had previously been to a dermatologist who had performed skin tests without finding a specific cause. Unfortunately, I wasn't given the time to calmly explain the situation.

I was told, in a tone I perceived as arrogant and aggressive, that I would still have to pay part of the appointment and that, if I wanted to schedule a new appointment, I would have to pay in advance. However, no one had informed me of this policy when I booked.

When I said that, after the way I'd been treated, I'd prefer to go to another clinic, I was told, "I'm very happy with that."

I can't judge the facility's medical expertise because I wasn't able to attend the appointment. However, I can judge the way I was treated over the phone, and unfortunately, I felt unheard, interrupted, and treated with little empathy. Anyone who takes in an animal with a chronic illness requires not only expertise, but also respect and professional communication.
Very kind and congratulations...
I've been a regular visitor for about two years now, they've never disappointed me, and above all, I've always found the doctors to be very knowledgeable and competent! Excellent!
Very kind. Competent. Welcoming.
Dr. Veronica is simply exceptional, she explains the situation in detail and treats the animals as if they were her own, thank you, Dr.

I took my dachshund to this clinic for some tests, and although the results weren't optimal initially, the experience was excellent. The staff is truly exceptional: they managed to put my little one, who usually hates vets, at ease, demonstrating extraordinary sensitivity.

You can clearly see that they do this work out of pure passion and love for animals, as well as being extremely competent. The operation went well, and he is already recovering. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team and staff for their support and professionalism.

I recommend this facility to all owners looking for the best for their four-legged companions.
Dr Avraham is very professional and genuinely care about our little Berlina. We don't have to amputate her and she is fully recovered. Thanks a million 💞 🐾 …
They have a lot of patience and expertise with the animals they see. An excellent clinic.
Very professional and always available
Dr. Avraham is helpful, kind, and knowledgeable. She was very clear and patiently answered all our questions. She was very empathetic with our little girl. A valuable help on all fronts.
Thank you for your review! Our team works hard every day to provide the best service possible.
We are happy to know that our efforts are appreciated and that you had a positive experience with us.

The clinic is spotlessly clean and smells great. They have a wide range of equipment and services for pets. They are incredibly kind, professional, and thorough in their explanations! They examined my puppy with extreme care and precision, taking care of every detail. They explained everything to me in detail and were extremely thorough in providing a diagnosis and appropriate treatment. I highly recommend them if you need a veterinary clinic. They are true angels for our four-legged friends. 🐾❤️ A special heartfelt thank you to Dr. Marassi, who was incredibly sweet and gave me a lot of confidence in facing the upcoming treatment. We need human doctors as good as they are! 10 out of 10 ❤️ Taz and Cookie 🍪
Thank you for your review! The entire team works hard every day to offer the best possible service, and your appreciation makes us very happy.
Always a guarantee of professionalism and great competence after 5 years of being treated by them.
Professional and experienced. Excellent welcome and services offered.
Thank you for sharing your experience and for your trust in us! We work passionately to ensure quality care and attention for all the pets who trust us.

Despite the rather high price, we were very well received by an all-female team of veterinarians who took the time to examine our dog 🐶 for an infestation caused by unwanted products. Thank you to the whole team. …
Dear M., we're pleased to hear that your experience at our clinic was positive, and we thank you for your feedback. Have a nice day from BluVet!
Dear Fabrizio, thank you so much for your positive review! We're really happy you enjoyed your experience.
Dear Mrs. Mascheroni, thank you so much for your 5-star review! It was a pleasure caring for your dog.

On Monday, March 31, I called to ask about the prices for the annual Ceppi and L4 booster vaccinations. They asked me if I was a new client, and I said yes: the price was €60. I scheduled an appointment for this morning, April 1, at 9:30 a.m.
Dr. Scotti performed a thorough examination, which included a stethoscope and a heart and lung auscultation (2 minutes). She then told me that although the previous vet had administered both the L4 and Ceppi vaccinations annually, the Ceppi vaccination is covered for three years and wasn't necessary. I asked twice why the previous vet had administered it annually, and she told me it was the doctor's decision without specifying anything else.
She then administered only one vaccination, the L4 vaccination.
I went to the receptionist's office to pay, and the receptionist put the POS in front of me without telling me the price. I asked how much it was, and she told me €60.
I chose not to start a discussion because the bad faith was obvious and I would have gotten needlessly angry. I paid and called once I was outside: the answer was "I don't know, he didn't speak to me."
Suspicious, I checked to see if the Ceppi vaccination, as their doctor said, lasts for 3 years and therefore there's no point in repeating it every year. I discovered that it lasts for 3 years for distemper, hepatitis, and paraviruses, but for canine parainfluenza, it only lasts for 1 year.
That's why my previous vet did it every year, and if Dr. Scotti had been honest and told me, I would have done it.
So in the end, they charged me 60 euros, which was supposed to be the price for a booster shot for two vaccinations, and they only gave me one, hiding some crucial information.
I'll leave the honesty and reliability of this clinic to be judged.
Now I'll have to spend more money and time to get the Ceppi vaccine, too, because they were so clever.
To be avoided and if I had time a report to the order would be due.
Dear Carlo, thank you so much for your positive review! We're so happy you enjoyed your experience.

Highly recommended clinic! Dr. Negri is always a guarantee. He lovingly cared for my dog ​​in a professional and attentive manner. His empathetic approach and expertise always impress me. Thank you so much, Dr. Negri!

We were visiting Milano and noticed something on my dog that catches my attention, I immediately looked for the closest veterinarian to my hotel, called last minute, explained the situation and they accommodated me for a same day appointment, very helpful staff, very clean clinic,  and most important, we spoke in perfect English with almost everyone.
Thank you for taking care of Bruno! Maybe he wasn’t ready to leave with the ‘cone of shame’ and after 5 days of treatment he’s looking a feeling way better!!

Thank you!!!!

Amazing amazing staff!!

I took my two-month-old puppy for an initial visit. The clinic offered excellent service, from the modern, well-maintained, clean, and tidy appearance to the staff, from the veterinarians to the various assistants. The check-up lasted an hour, everything was described in detail and with the utmost courtesy and professionalism.
You can't find a better place to go!
Competent doctors who are very affectionate towards their patients!
130 euros plus 30 of medication for a 30-minute dermatological visit from which nothing emerged, except for vague and unsubstantiated speeches, you have lost a potential customer.
A guarantee

Professional, helpful, and truly a cut above the rest. Dr. Avraham is simply fantastic. Heartfelt thanks to Dr. Jommi and Dr. Avraham, who operated on my dog; to the anesthesiologist Dr. Ferretti, who is always attentive and meticulous; and …
The staff is really kind and helpful. Dr. Marassi is fantastic.
Thank you!
Excellent service, 10/10. Highly recommended.
